references.text: The Lord gives Moses instructions to lead the children of Israel, whom He refers to as His 'sheep', reflecting the idea of God's people as sheep in need of guidance.
This verse describes how all who are like sheep have gone astray, which reflects the concept of the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
Jesus expresses that He was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel, which directly corresponds with the instructions in Matthew 10:6.
The parable of the lost sheep illustrates Jesus' care for the lost, which is consistent with the mission given in Matthew 10:6.
